snippet.title: THE BIORIFT - Official Teaser Trailer | 2.5D Action-Shooter
snippet.description:
Dive into the neon-drenched dystopia of THE BIORIFT, a 2.5D action-shooter with metroidvania exploration and episodic storytelling. In the fractured city of RIFT, rogue AIs, mutated biotech constructs, and deadly cults battle for control. You’re not a hero—you’re the accidental carrier of a weapon that could end it all.

https://thebiorift.com/

Experience dynamic combat, explore distorted cyberworlds, and unravel a gripping story of betrayal and survival. Crafted by DarkForge Studio, veterans of Dragon Age, Call of Duty, and Atomic Heart, this indie game blends anime-inspired battles with biopunk aesthetics.

Inspired by 1990s Hollywood sci-fi classics like Blade Runner and The Matrix, THE BIORIFT delivers a bold, gritty narrative in every frame.

Are you ready to survive the betrayal and forge your path in RIFT?
